answer: The opal schedule is applied in onyx and comet reveals each instalment. An attacker thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 60% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3604 identities would post 4296 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
